threads.title: The Empty Stand
threads.intro: Find out what stood on the display stand and who formally looked after the prop.
threads.outcome_text: The finale used the replica, the original turned up later in a repair case, and Dev held the custody duty.

threads.title: The Swap Window
threads.intro: Separate being nearby from handling the mask, and rebuild the minutes in which the replica took its place.
threads.outcome_text: Nikhil was onstage before the original came back, and the movements show Dev moving both masks.

threads.title: The Cover Story
threads.intro: Test the cue operator theory and read the private messages that explain why the move was kept quiet.
threads.outcome_text: Kavya’s cue shows the wrong item but no handling, and Dev’s messages explain and admit the unlogged move.

story_events.title: A replica at the reveal
story_events.body: The post-finale check finds the replica on the display stand and no original serial plate. A later check finds the original, clasp taped, in Repair Case 2. The role table names Dev as prop custody lead.

story_events.title: Eight minutes
story_events.body: Between 18:55 and 19:08 the original comes back to the prop bay, the replica goes to the stage-left wing and then to the display stand. Nikhil’s credential exits toward the stage at 18:54.

story_events.title: Do not update the producer
story_events.body: Dev’s direct message at 18:58 asks Sana to put the backup on the wing and not to update the producer. At 19:16 he writes that the original is in Repair Case 2 and that he should have logged the move.
